headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted two Ansar Allah ballistic missiles toward Najran and a drone over the Makkah region on Friday
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- coalition spokesman al-Malki, X, Fri Nov 6] Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah militia toward Najran in southwestern Saudi Arabia; debris fell following the interceptions and damage was being assessed; no…
sources: Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Malki, posts on X (Nov 6), carried by Gulf News / Arab News / Turkiye Today
fault_line: A drone over Mecca — intercepted, Riyadh says. The Ansar Allah say they never target the holy cities. Who do you believe?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- coalition spokesman al-Malki, X, Fri Nov 6] Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah militia toward Najran in southwestern Saudi Arabia; debris fell following the interceptions and damage was being assessed; no casualties confirmed. Separately, the coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone in the Makkah region; al-Malki did not identify the drone's origin or intended target. Saudi Civil Defence issued a Najran emergency alert (National Early Warning Platform) and later lifted it, saying the danger had passed. [CONTEXT] Second day running of holy-city targeting claims: Thursday Nov 5 the coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile toward the Medina region plus a drone in the Eastern Province (recorded 0500-01; Ansar Allah denial on record). The Ansar Allah have not claimed or denied Friday's Makkah drone as of this scan. AJ's Oct 30 Mecca-drone piece re-crawled today is a RE-DATE -- do not use for this incident.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct registered families carry the coalition statement: Gulf News (T3) + Arab News (T3). Turkiye Today, Siasat and Pakistan Today carry the same coalition posts but have NO declared tier in the registry and do not count toward corroboration. The coalition's own X posts are the primary source behind both families.
sections.what_disputed: No independent verification of the launches, trajectories or interceptions; no debris or video published; the coalition did not disclose the Makkah drone's origin or target. The Ansar Allah denied targeting the holy cities on Thursday (Saree, recorded 0500-01) but have not addressed Friday's Makkah drone. The Najran civil-defence alert was issued and lifted the same day with no incident attached beyond the interception claim. Thursday's Medina claim and Friday's Makkah claim follow the same pattern (coalition claim, no independent evidence).
sections.why_matters: Two missiles at Najran. A drone over Mecca. One day after Medina. The holy cities are now the front line — and nobody has shown a single piece of debris.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (coalition X posts Friday morning; Gulf News liveblog 11:36 + 11:48 ; Arab News updated 13:34 ; Turkiye Today 13:48+03:00 = 14:48 ; zero 'Makkah' mentions in any prior Nov 6 scan -- grep confirms) -- Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted two Ansar Allah ballistic missiles toward Najran and a drone over the Makkah region on Friday

totw_analysis: Our read: Two missiles at Najran. A drone over Mecca. One day after Medina. The holy cities are now the front line — and nobody has shown a single piece of debris. The fault line our audience is arguing over: A drone over Mecca — intercepted, Riyadh says. The Ansar Allah say they never target the holy cities. Who do you believe?
